extensionDescription.message: Hands downloads to MagicPlus with the cookies and referer the site expects.

notConnectedBody.message: Open the extension and connect it once.

appNotRunningBody.message: Start MagicPlus, then check again. Its download manager has to be on.

connectBody.message: Connecting asks MagicPlus for permission — it puts a dialog on screen naming this extension.

connectedBody.message: Downloads are handed over with the cookies and referer this browser would have sent, which is what keeps signed links working.

refused.message: MagicPlus refused the connection. Press Connect to ask again.

sniffMedia.message: Offer video playing on a page

contextHint.message: Right-click any link, video, image — or the page itself — to send it over even when auto-catch is off.
